Show publish failure and<br>return" vertex="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;fontSize=14;fontColor=#12263a;fillColor=#ffffff;;fontFamily=Arial;" sourceEvidence="["mobile:src/hooks/useReelCreator.ts:547-555"]"><mxGeometry x="172" y="3700" width="235" height="48" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="title" value="27 · Upload retry and duplicate effects" vertex="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;fontSize=27;fontColor=#12263a;fillColor=#ffffff;;fontFamily=Arial;"><mxGeometry x="28" y="20" width="1634" height="45" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="subtitle" value="At most two whole upload/create attempts; fresh object key and Reel/outbox identities can duplicate effects after a lost create response." vertex="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;fontSize=15;fontColor=#12263a;fillColor=#ffffff;;fontFamily=Arial;"><mxGeometry x="28" y="68" width="1634" height="62" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="legend" value="SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.<br>Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.<br>Loop uses logical stop conditions equivalent to source for-loop plus break, not an idempotency key. Presign/upload failures skip the later steps inside explicit operands.<br>A server commit followed by lost HTTP response leaves no known reelCreated marker; another attempt generates a different random object key and new Reel/outbox IDs.<br>The storage SDK presigns locally; no fabricated Media-&gt;R2 presign network request. Logical RMQ RPC abstracts envelopes; presign and upload failure operands stop later steps.<br>Current mobile getReelUploadUrl sends fileType only; gateway purpose defaults to chat, so video key uses chat-videos rather than an assumed reels prefix. This is current source behavior, not an app change." vertex="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;fontSize=13;fontColor=#12263a;fillColor=#ffffff;;fontFamily=Arial;"><mxGeometry x="28" y="3876" width="1634" height="120" as="geometry" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
Loop uses logical stop conditions equivalent to source for-loop plus break, not an idempotency key. Presign/upload failures skip the later steps inside explicit operands.
A server commit followed by lost HTTP response leaves no known reelCreated marker; another attempt generates a different random object key and new Reel/outbox IDs.
The storage SDK presigns locally; no fabricated Media->R2 presign network request. Logical RMQ RPC abstracts envelopes; presign and upload failure operands stop later steps.
Current mobile getReelUploadUrl sends fileType only; gateway purpose defaults to chat, so video key uses chat-videos rather than an assumed reels prefix. This is current source behavior, not an app change.
